rows.rule: in every analysed 1 s window, the hottest sensor is at most 4 °C above the mean
one shire at full load does not widen the gap beyond a central 2 × 2 block (median, per block)
each load’s median gap is within ±1 °C of idle’s
no wrong result, tensor error or failed launch among the checked launches, at any temperature
each kernel’s cycles at a mean of 80–85 °C within 0.1% of rest
the heater’s implied clock 0.5994–0.5995 GHz in every 5 °C band
under the whole-chip heater, the gap at most +4 °C in every band
the gap’s median grows by 0 or +1 °C from 60–70 to 80–85 °C
the DRAM refresh period stays 2,325.4 ± 0.1 minion cycles when hot
idle board power within ±1.5 W of the card’s September idle law, per degree
